parts.text:
To log in to your Microsoft account, you can access the official sign-in page using the link below:

👉 **[Sign in to your Microsoft Account](https://login.live.com/)** (or visit **[account.microsoft.com](https://account.microsoft.com/)**)

### 🔒 Safety Tip
Always ensure the URL in your browser's address bar starts with **`https://login.live.com/`** or **`https://account.microsoft.com/`** before entering your password to protect your account from phishing attempts.

---

### Having trouble logging in?
If you cannot sign in, choose one of the options below:

* **Forgot your password?**
  Go to the **[Microsoft Password Reset page](https://account.live.com/ResetPassword.aspx)** to verify your identity and set a new password.
* **Forgot your username/email?**
  Go to the login page, click **Sign-in options**, and select **Forgot my username** to search for your account using your security phone number or recovery email.
* **Locked out of your account?**
  If your account has been locked or suspended, you can submit an **[Account Recovery Form](https://account.live.com/acsr)** to request access restore.

### What can you access with your Microsoft Account?
Once logged in, you can manage and access all Microsoft services, including:
* **Outlook.com** (Hotmail/Live email)
* **Microsoft 365 / Office** (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* **OneDrive** cloud storage
* **Xbox / PC Gaming** services
* **Windows** device settings and licenses
